title: Estimate Form Standards by Type: Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
The printed Good Faith & Price Estimates form differs by estimate type in the co-provider lines it carries, the basis of Riverbend's own expected charges, the number of lines a version may hold, whether expected diagnosis codes are listed, and the disclaimer printed on it.

| Estimate type | Co-provider lines carried | Co-provider roles included | Basis of Riverbend's own expected charges | Maximum lines on one version | Expected diagnosis codes listed | Standard disclaimer | Years retained and available to the patient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Single Scheduled Service | no | none | gross charges less the uninsured discount | 40 | yes | No Surprises Act good faith estimate disclaimer | 6 |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers | yes | anesthesia, pathology, radiology | gross charges less the uninsured discount | 60 | yes | No Surprises Act good faith estimate disclaimer | 6 |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care | no | none | gross charges less the uninsured discount | 120 | yes | No Surprises Act good faith estimate disclaimer | 6 |
| Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate | no | none | contracted rate applied to remaining benefits | 40 | no | insured estimate, not a guarantee | 6 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics | no | none | fixed package price | 10 | yes | No Surprises Act good faith estimate disclaimer with package terms | 6 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery | yes | anesthesia, pathology | fixed package price | 30 | yes | No Surprises Act good faith estimate disclaimer with package terms | 6 |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery | yes | anesthesia | fixed package price | 30 | yes | No Surprises Act good faith estimate disclaimer with package terms | 6 |

## Points of reading

- A co-provider role not listed for a type is not carried on that type's form: the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery carries an anesthesia co-provider line but no pathology or radiology line.
- The three package types share the fixed-package-price basis; the three self-pay good faith estimate types share the gross-charges-less-uninsured-discount basis; the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate alone uses the contracted rate applied to remaining benefits.
- Example (hypothetical): a recurring course whose expected items would need 130 lines exceeds the 120-line maximum of the Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care for a single version.
